title: Killing a Toyota Part 1 | Top Gear | BBC
summary: Top Gear episode in which Jeremy Clarkson and team try to destroy a Toyota Hilux pickup through water, fire, and a demolished building. It is the first part of the 'Killing a Toyota' series.
why: HN uses it as the go-to evidence for Toyota pickup durability, and as a benchmark in discussions of truck toughness.

quote.text: It's a worthwhile watch if you want to see truck survive after being drowned in water, fire, and the rubble of a demolished skyscraper.
